name: Greenbrier
summary: CCC-built fire tower on Greenbrier Pinnacle in the Smokies, photographed in 1935; the Tennessee list marks it removed, and a 2024 hike report mentions the old site without visiting it.
design: Fire tower with a cabin, built by the Civilian Conservation Corps
status_note: The Tennessee lookout list marks the tower removed. A 2024 hike report says the group did not go up to the old tower site.

access.note: Inside Great Smoky Mountains National Park. The former tower trail is a rough manway that the 2024 report describes as unmaintained.

visit.trail_note: The former Greenbrier Pinnacle trail has not been maintained since at least the early 1990s and is now a rough manway (2024 hike report).

events.note: Park photograph dated 1935-09-03 is labelled as taken during construction or shortly after. The Mountain Press caption credits the Civilian Conservation Corps with building the tower and cabin.
A 2024 hike report says the group did not go up to the old tower site on the pinnacle. It describes an overgrown former jeep road and an unmaintained trail.
The Tennessee lookout list marks the tower removed. No removal date is given.
